bridge_developer_instructions: The registered dynamic tools are executed by the existing Claude SDK inside the isolated task container using their original permissions. The Codex host filesystem policy does not restrict these external tools. Follow the original role instructions and actual tool results, including any role-specific read-only restrictions. Do not infer a container write failure from the host policy. Never use native Codex filesystem or command tools.
